1.text: Woe to those who give less [than due],<sup foot_note="228197">1</sup>

footnotes.228197: - i.e., those who cheat people by giving them less than what they paid for when weighing or measuring - an amount so little as to hardly be noticed.

2.text: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

3.text: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

4.text: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

6.text: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

7.text: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.

8.text: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

9.text: It is [their destination<sup foot_note="228198">1</sup> recorded in] a register inscribed.

10.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

11.text: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

12.text: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

13.text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

14.text: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.<sup foot_note="228199">1</sup>

15.text: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.<sup foot_note="228200">1</sup>

footnotes.228200: - i.e., they will not be able to see Him.

16.text: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

17.text: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

18.text: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.

19.text: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?

20.text: It is [their destination<sup foot_note="228201">1</sup> recorded in] a register inscribed

21.text: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].

22.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

24.text: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

25.text: They will be given to drink [pure] wine<sup foot_note="228202">1</sup> [which was] sealed.

footnotes.228202: - Which is delicious and does not intoxicate.

26.text: The last of it<sup foot_note="228203">1</sup> is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.

27.text: And its mixture is of Tasneem,<sup foot_note="228204">1</sup>

footnotes.228204: - The highest spring in Paradise and the most favored drink of its inhabitants.

28.text: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

29.text: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

30.text: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

31.text: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

32.text: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

33.text: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

34.text: So Today<sup foot_note="228205">1</sup> those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

36.text: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
